# VPasModule
- CREATED BY: Vadim Melamed
- EMAIL: vpasmodule@gmail.com

# Version
- 15.0.1

# How To Use VPasModule
- Step1: Install VPasModule from github or from Powershell Gallery https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/VpasModule/15.0.1
- Step2: Import VPasModule Required Version 15.0.1 into Powershell
- Step3: Retrieve Cyberark Login Token via New-VPASToken
- Step4: Run desired API calls
- Step5: Invalidate Cyberark Login Token via Remove-VPASToken
  - Example:
    ```
    Import-Module VPasModule
    $PVWA = "MyPVWAServer.domain.com"
    New-VPASToken -PVWA $PVWA -AuthType cyberark
    Get-VPASSafes -searchQuery "TestSafe"
    Remove-VPASToken
    ```

NAME
    Import-VPASDiscoveredAccount
    
SYNOPSIS
    Onboard discovered account
    CREATED BY: Vadim Melamed, EMAIL: vpasmodule@gmail.com
    
    
SYNTAX
    Import-VPASDiscoveredAccount -SearchQuery <String> [-PlatformType <String>] [-Privileged <String>] [-Enabled <String>] -OnboardToSafe <String> -OnboardToPlatform <String> [-additionalProperties <Hashtable>] [-Secret <String>] [-RotateSecret] [-token <Hashtable>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Import-VPASDiscoveredAccount -DiscoveredAccountID <String> -OnboardToSafe <String> -OnboardToPlatform <String> [-additionalProperties <Hashtable>] [-Secret <String>] [-RotateSecret] [-token <Hashtable>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    Import-VPASDiscoveredAccount -InputParameters <Hashtable> [-token <Hashtable>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Use this function to onboard a specific discovered account from the pending account list
    

PARAMETERS
    -SearchQuery <String>
        Search string to find target resource via username, address, safe, platform, etc.
        Separate by space for multiple fields, or to search all pass a blank value like so: " "
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -PlatformType <String>
        Limit the scope of accounts returned based on PlatformType
        Possible values: Windows Server Local, Windows Desktop Local, Windows Domain, Unix, Unix SSH Key, AWS, AWS Access Keys, Azure Password Management
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Privileged <String>
        Limit the scope of accounts returned based on Privileged status
        Possible values: true, false
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Enabled <String>
        Limit the scope of accounts returned based in account status
        Possible values: true, false
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -DiscoveredAccountID <String>
        Unique ID that maps to a single account, passing this variable will skip any query functions
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OnboardToSafe <String>
        Target safe the discovered account will be onboarded to
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OnboardToPlatform <String>
        Target platform the discovered account will be onboarded to
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -additionalProperties <Hashtable>
        Include extra properties that can be defined based on platform settings and configurations
        Pass extra properties in a hashtable following this pattern: @{ PropertyTag = "PropertyValue" }
        Example: -additionalProperties @{ Notes = "onboarded from discovery" }
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -Secret <String>
        Initial secret to be set for the discovered account upon onboarding
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -RotateSecret [<SwitchParameter>]
        Whether the secret of the discovered account will be rotated upon onboarding

NAME

    CREATED BY: Vadim Melamed, EMAIL: vpasmodule@gmail.com

    Use this function to authenticate into Idira (formerly CyberArk) for SelfHosted and PrivilegeCloudStandard environments (RADIUS, CYBERARK, WINDOWS, SAML, LDAP, AUTHTOKEN), SharedServices environments (CYBERARK, OAUTH, AUTHTOKEN), as well as SRS enabled environments (CYBERARK, OAUTH, AUTHTOKEN)
    

PARAMETERS

        The baseURL for saas environments: MyCompany.privilegecloud.cyberark.cloud

        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuthType <String>
        What method of authentication will be used
        For saas environments, select the ispss options
        Possible values: cyberark, radius, windows, ldap, saml, authtoken, ispss_oauth, ispss_cyberark, ispss_authtoken, srs_cyberark, srs_oauth, srs_authtoken
        
        Required?                    true
        Position?                    2
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -creds <PSCredential>

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    3
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -HideAscii [<SwitchParameter>]

        Position?                    4
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    5
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -InitiateCookie [<SwitchParameter>]

        Required?                    false
        Position?                    6
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -IdentityURL <String>

        Position?                    7

        Accept pipeline input?       true (ByPropertyName)
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -AuthToken <String>
